statement: Nvidia posted 13% sequential growth in hyperscale revenue during Q2 of fiscal year 2027, per this trade report.
why: Sequential hyperscale revenue growth is the most direct read on whether the largest cloud buyers are still increasing merchant-GPU purchases quarter to quarter.

impact.mechanism: Continued sequential revenue growth from hyperscale customers indicates order flow for datacenter GPUs is still expanding rather than plateauing.

evidence.excerpt: 13% sequential growth in hyperscale revenue during Q2 of its fiscal year 2027.

confidence.basis: Secondary open-web trade outlet only; no filing or transcript cited in the document, and the piece flags parts of its reporting as unconfirmed.
